result.summary: Found 2 issues: overlapping/garbled delivery time text on a popular restaurant card, and a notification badge sitting too close to the status bar.

issues.description: On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery time text is broken and overlapping: it reads as '25-30elivery' with the word 'delivery' colliding into the time range.
issues.suggestion: Give the time and 'delivery' labels separate layout space (or a proper string like '25–30 min delivery') so they never overlap.

issues.description: The red notification badge on the bell icon sits very close to the status bar and can look cramped or clipped against the top edge.
issues.suggestion: Add more top padding or inset the badge so it sits clearly within the header.
